newsitem.title: USA: Tyco Toys offers video camera for kids.
newsitem.headline: Tyco Toys offers video camera for kids.

text.p: Tyco Toys Inc said on Thursday that its video camera for children, Tyco VideoCam, was available in retail stores, and company anticipated a potential shortage of them in the fourth quarter.
The lightweight camera, for children aged six through 12, retails for about $100, the company said in a statement. It has no moving parts and only one button to operate.

"We're working at peak production capacity to try to meet the strong worldwide demand for Tyco VideoCmam," Tyco Toys Inc Executive Vice President Michael Lynden said in a statement. He said mail-order catalog sales were also very strong.
